data.title: 角楯花凛 · 都会街角的运动便服等待
data.description: 周末喧闹的学园都市林荫街角，微风拂动行道树叶洒下斑驳光影。花凛身着深灰无袖短连帽衫与牛仔短裤，小麦色马甲线与修长健美的大长腿一览无余。她单手握着易拉罐冰咖啡倚靠在行道树旁，远远看到赶来的老师，熔金色的眼眸顿时浮现出安心的笑意。
data.location: sunny city street corner under green tree shade
data.action: leaning casually against tree, holding iced drink can, relaxed athletic stance
data.lighting: dappled sunlight through tree foliage onto tanned skin
data.mood: relaxed weekend freedom and youthful athletic energy
data.promptProse: Leaning casually against a sidewalk tree in a cropped sleeveless grey hoodie and denim shorts, Kakudate Karin holds an iced coffee, her golden eyes lighting up warmly.
data.animaCaption: Karin waiting casually on the street corner in a sleeveless hoodie.
